newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ITT, Litton win Australian order.
newsitem.headline: ITT, Litton win Australian order.

text.p: ITT Industries Inc and Litton Industries Inc, both of the United States, will supply the Australian Defence Force with night fighting equipment under contracts worth more than A$100 million, the Defence Department said on Monday.
ITT, in partnership with British Aerospace Plc, has been contracted to supply equipment including night vision goggles, night weapon sights and night aiming devices, the department said.
Australia will buy night sights for sniper rifles from Litton Electro-Optical Systems.
The companies have been contracted through their subsidiaries ITT Night Vision, Litton Electro-Optical Systems and British Aerospace Australia, the department said.
The equipment purchase, which is part of the Australian Defence Force's (ADF) Project Ninox, will be awarded later in 1997 with the first deliveries in mid-1998.
"It aims to give the ADF the capability to detect, monitor and engage an enemy force at night, thus enhancing the ability to conduct operations 24 hours a day," the department said.
British Aerospace Australia, based in Adelaide, will be responsible for assembling and testing most of the night vision equipment.
